source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python -c "
import json, os
# Search ALL json files for one with per-task TSR values matching 0.74, 0.80, 0.66, 0.66
base = '/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/'
for fname in os.listdir(base):
    if not fname.endswith('.json'):
        continue
    f = base + fname
    d = json.load(open(f))
    # Check per_task format
    tasks = d.get('results', d.get('per_task', []))
    if len(tasks) != 4:
        continue
    tsrs = [t['TSR'] for t in tasks]
    cars = [t['CAR'] for t in tasks]
    avg_tsr = sum(tsrs)/4
    avg_car = sum(cars)/4
    # Check if any file has TSR close to 0.715 or per-task 74/80/66/66
    if abs(avg_tsr - 0.715) < 0.01 or (0.74 in tsrs and 0.80 in tsrs):
        print(f'CANDIDATE: {fname}')
        print(f'  TSRs: {tsrs}, avg={avg_tsr}')
        print(f'  CARs: {cars}, avg={avg_car}')
        c = d.get('config', {})
        print(f'  seed={c.get(\"seed\")}, model={c.get(\"model\",c.get(\"config_name\",\"?\"))}')
    # Also check for CAR=0.55 match (LoRA s2)
    if abs(avg_car - 0.55) < 0.01:
        print(f'CAR55 CANDIDATE: {fname}')
        print(f'  CARs: {cars}, avg={avg_car}')
        c = d.get('config', {})
        print(f'  seed={c.get(\"seed\")}, ckpt={c.get(\"checkpoint\",\"?\")}')
"
